title: Microsoft 365 Fundamentals
subtitle: Climb the money ladder -- one Microsoft 365 question per grade level

questions.q: Microsoft 365 is delivered as which cloud service model?
questions.note: M365 is a SaaS offering -- Microsoft manages the infrastructure, platform, and software; customers just use it.

explain.correct: M365 is Software as a Service: Microsoft hosts and manages all infrastructure and software, and customers access it over the internet via subscription.
wrong: IaaS provides raw compute/storage/networking (like Azure VMs). M365 is fully managed software, not raw infrastructure.
PaaS provides a development platform for building apps (like Azure App Service). M365 is a finished productivity suite, not a dev platform.
On-premises software is installed and managed locally by the organization. M365 is cloud-hosted by Microsoft -- that is the defining difference.

questions.q: Which Microsoft 365 application is the primary client for email and calendar?
questions.note: Outlook is the M365 client for email and calendar; the backend cloud service is Exchange Online.

explain.correct: Microsoft Outlook is the dedicated email and calendar client in M365. The cloud service powering it is Exchange Online.
wrong: Teams is the hub for chat, meetings, and collaboration -- not the primary email or calendar client.
SharePoint is a document management and intranet platform, not an email or calendar client.
OneNote is a digital notebook for notes and note-sharing, not email or calendar.

questions.q: Microsoft Teams is PRIMARILY designed to serve as what kind of platform?
options: A teamwork hub for chat, channels, and meetings
A device and endpoint management console
questions.note: Teams is the M365 teamwork hub: persistent chat, channels, video meetings (up to 1000 attendees), and integrated apps.

explain.correct: Teams is the teamwork hub in M365 -- it combines persistent chat, channels, video/audio meetings, and integrations with the rest of the M365 suite.
wrong: File storage is handled by OneDrive (personal) and SharePoint (shared/team). Teams surfaces those files but is not the storage service itself.
Business intelligence and reporting is the role of Power BI, not Teams.
Device and endpoint management is handled by Microsoft Intune, not Teams.

questions.q: What is the DEFAULT OneDrive for Business storage allocation per user in Microsoft 365?
questions.note: OneDrive for Business provisions 1 TB of cloud storage per licensed user by default across most M365 plans.

explain.correct: Microsoft 365 provisions 1 TB of OneDrive for Business storage per user by default across Business and Enterprise plans.
wrong: 100 GB is the Exchange Online mailbox size in E3/E5 plans -- not the OneDrive default.
500 GB is not a documented OneDrive for Business default allocation.
5 TB is available to users who sync more than 1 TB and is granted by Microsoft automatically, but the stated default at provisioning is 1 TB.

questions.q: According to Microsoft, enabling Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) blocks approximately what percentage of account-compromise attacks?
questions.note: Microsoft's own research states MFA blocks approximately 99.9% of automated account-compromise attacks.

explain.correct: Microsoft research shows MFA blocks approximately 99.9% of automated credential attacks, making it the single most impactful identity control.
wrong: 50% is far too low. MFA is dramatically more effective than this figure suggests.
75% understates MFA effectiveness. The real figure from Microsoft research is close to 99.9%.
90% is still a significant understatement of MFA's documented effectiveness against automated attacks.

questions.q: When a user shares a file inside a Microsoft Teams CHANNEL, which Microsoft 365 service actually stores that file?
questions.note: Teams channel files are stored in a SharePoint Online document library associated with the team; Teams chat files go to OneDrive.

explain.correct: Files shared in a Teams CHANNEL are stored in the team's connected SharePoint Online document library. This is a key architectural distinction for M365.
wrong: OneDrive for Business stores files shared in Teams private CHAT conversations -- not channel files.
Exchange Online stores Teams chat messages in a hidden mailbox folder, not shared files.
Azure Blob Storage is a raw cloud object store used by developers. M365 end-user content does not route through it directly.

questions.q: Microsoft Entra ID, the cloud identity and access management service central to M365, was formerly known as what?
questions.note: Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) was rebranded to Microsoft Entra ID in 2023. It is the cloud identity backbone of M365.

explain.correct: Microsoft rebranded Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) to Microsoft Entra ID in July 2023. It remains the cloud identity and access management service for M365.
wrong: Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) is the on-premises directory service running on Windows Server -- it is a separate product from the cloud service.
Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM) is an on-premises identity lifecycle management product, not the cloud identity service.
Windows Server Directory Services is not a distinct named Microsoft product -- this refers generically to AD DS on Windows Server, an on-premises technology.

questions.q: Which Microsoft Defender component is a Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) that discovers shadow IT and monitors cloud app usage?
questions.note: Defender for Cloud Apps is the CASB in M365. It discovers unsanctioned cloud app usage (shadow IT) and enforces app governance policies.

explain.correct: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is the CASB solution. It discovers shadow IT, monitors cloud app behavior, and applies data and access controls across SaaS apps.
wrong: Defender for Endpoint is an Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platform for protecting devices -- not a CASB.
Defender for Office 365 provides email protection via Safe Links and Safe Attachments -- it is not a CASB.
Defender for Identity monitors on-premises Active Directory for identity-based threats -- it does not discover cloud app usage.

questions.q: Which Microsoft 365 plan tier is the ONLY one that bundles Teams Phone System, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 2, AND Power BI Pro together?
questions.note: E5 is the only M365 plan that includes Defender for Endpoint P2, Teams Phone System, and Power BI Pro as integrated components.

explain.correct: Microsoft 365 E5 is the only plan tier that includes all three: Teams Phone System, Defender for Endpoint Plan 2, and Power BI Pro, plus the full E5 security and compliance stack.
wrong: M365 E3 includes Defender for Endpoint P1 and Intune natively, but does not include Teams Phone System or Power BI Pro.
Business Premium includes Defender for Business (not Defender for Endpoint P2), no Teams Phone System, and no Power BI Pro. It also caps at 300 users.
M365 F3 (Frontline) is a web/mobile-only plan for frontline workers and does not include Teams Phone System, Defender for Endpoint P2, or Power BI Pro.

questions.q: Conditional Access policies in Microsoft Entra ID -- which enforce if/then access rules based on signals like device state and location -- require at minimum which license?
options: Microsoft Entra ID Free (included with M365)
No license is required; Conditional Access is available to all tenants
questions.note: Conditional Access requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 at minimum. P1 is included in M365 Business Premium, E3, and E5.

explain.correct: Conditional Access is a Microsoft Entra ID P1 feature. P1 is included in M365 Business Premium, E3, and E5 -- but NOT in Free or the base M365 plans without those tiers.
wrong: Entra ID Free (included with any M365 subscription) provides basic identity features and Security Defaults, but does NOT include Conditional Access policy creation.
Entra ID P2 builds on P1 and adds Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and Identity Protection risk policies. Conditional Access itself only requires P1.
Conditional Access is NOT available to all tenants without a license. It is a premium feature gated behind P1 (or plans that include it).

questions.q: A compliance officer needs to download the actual SOC 2 Type II audit report for Microsoft's cloud services. Which resource provides that authenticated access, and how does it differ from the public-facing Trust Center?
options: The Trust Center (trustcenter.microsoft.com) provides both public commitments and downloadable audit reports in one place after login

The Service Trust Portal (servicetrust.microsoft.com) is the authenticated portal where Microsoft publishes SOC, ISO, and other third-party audit reports; the Trust Center (microsoft.com/trust-center) is the public-facing site explaining Microsoft's privacy and security commitments
The Microsoft Compliance Manager replaces both the Trust Center and Service Trust Portal and is where all audit reports are downloaded
Audit reports are only available by submitting a request to Microsoft Support; neither the Trust Center nor the Service Trust Portal provides direct downloads
questions.note: Service Trust Portal = authenticated download hub for SOC/ISO reports. Trust Center = public commitment explanations. These are distinct resources with different access models.

explain.correct: The Service Trust Portal (servicetrust.microsoft.com) requires authentication and hosts downloadable third-party audit reports (SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.). The Trust Center (microsoft.com/trust-center) is the public marketing and reference site explaining Microsoft's security, privacy, and compliance commitments -- no login required, no audit reports.
wrong: The Trust Center does NOT provide downloadable audit reports. It explains commitments publicly. The Service Trust Portal is the separate authenticated site for actual reports.

Compliance Manager is a tool within Microsoft Purview for assessing your organization's compliance posture and managing control actions -- it is not where you download Microsoft's own third-party audit reports.
SOC and ISO audit reports ARE directly downloadable from the Service Trust Portal after authenticating with a Microsoft account. A support request is not required.
